title: Corey Haines's lead magnet playbook: pick, gate, deliver, and measure email-capture offers
summary: An open-source agent skill by Corey Haines that lays out how to plan a lead magnet: solve one specific problem, match the buyer stage, keep it quick to consume, and tie it naturally to the product. It covers format choice, gating level, landing page structure, delivery, promotion, and the metrics and tests to track.

principles.text: Build each lead magnet around one specific pain point, not a broad topic.
principles.quote: Address one clear pain point, not a broad topic

principles.text: Match the lead magnet format to the buyer's stage: educate at awareness, help evaluate at consideration, help implement at decision.
principles.quote:
Awareness leads need education
- Consideration leads need comparison and evaluation
- Decision leads need implementation help

principles.text: Make it feel worth paying for but consumable fast, ideally in under 10 minutes, with an immediate actionable takeaway.
Choose a lead magnet that solves a problem your product also solves, so it leads naturally to adoption.
principles.quote: Solves a problem your product also solves

principles.text: Ask for the minimum info needed on the capture form, because each extra field costs conversions.
principles.quote: Ask for the minimum needed. Every extra field reduces conversion by 5-10%.

principles.text: Create post-specific content upgrades on blog posts rather than relying on generic sidebar CTAs.
principles.quote: Content upgrades convert 2-5x better than generic sidebar CTAs
